title: Crew Oxygen Cylinder — Removal
abstract: Removal of the crew oxygen cylinder from its cradle with the floor panel lift, the strap release sequence and the neck examination that finds cradle chafe before it becomes a rejection.

sections.purpose: This task removes the crew oxygen cylinder from its cradle so that it can be sent for hydrostatic test, exchanged, or so that the transducer and non-return valve behind it can be changed.
sections.job_setup_note: The cylinder is heavy and awkward and the working position is poor. Two people are needed and a lifting strap must be used; do not carry it by the neck. The system must be depressurised and confirmed at zero before the outlet is broken. Have the replacement cylinder or a blanking cap ready before you start.
sections.procedure: 1. Do the depressurisation part of the servicing task and confirm zero pressure at the charging point. WARNING: OXYGEN. CONFIRM ZERO PRESSURE BEFORE ANY FITTING IS BROKEN. A CHARGED CYLINDER RELEASED FROM ITS CRADLE BECOMES A PROJECTILE. 2. Put the warning notices in position. 3. Lift the crew rest floor panel in zone 215 and secure it clear. 4. Disconnect the transducer electrical connector and cap it. 5. Break the outlet union at the non-return valve D3510118104447 and cap both halves immediately. 6. Fit the lifting strap around the cylinder body, not the neck. 7. Release the cradle strap in the sequence marked on the cradle. CAUTION: RELEASE THE STRAPS IN THE MARKED SEQUENCE. RELEASING THE AFT STRAP FIRST LETS THE CYLINDER ROLL FORWARD AGAINST THE OUTLET. 8. Lift the cylinder clear with two people and put it in the transport cradle. 9. Examine the cylinder neck where the strap bears for chafe, and record the depth of any mark. 10. Examine the cradle saddle for wear and for embedded grit. 11. Where the charging pump connection YS788350-31 must be disturbed for access, cap it as soon as it is broken. 12. Cover the cradle and the open unions.
sections.close_out: Record the neck chafe depth and the cradle saddle condition. Where chafe is recorded on two consecutive removals, raise the cradle for the moulded saddle rework. Keep the cylinder upright in the transport cradle and do not lay it on its side.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the strap release sequence differs on cradles with the moulded saddle

safety_precautions: Confirm zero pressure before breaking the outlet.
Use a lifting strap around the body, not the neck.
No oil, no grease near any oxygen fitting.
